theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_polygonal_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (p v : ι → Euclid P) (I : ι → Set ℝ) (c : ι → ℤ), (∀ k, ‖v k‖ = 1) → (∀ k, IsOpen (I k)) → (∀ j k, j ≠ k → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (((fun t : ℝ => p j + t • v j) '' I j) ∩ closure ((fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k)) = 0) → ∃ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), R.Represents X ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, X ω = ∑ k, (c k : ℝ) * ∫ t in I k, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (p k + t • v k) (fun _ => v k)) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal |(c k : ℝ)| * volume (I k ∩ (fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) ⁻¹' A)
